tickets.title: A generation transition that does not adopt the changed member says so, or is refused (**amendment 4, 2026-10-17**)

authority.locator: P50 · section 2 of amendment 4; the P49 delivery review section 10 (7.3)
authority.requirement: on both hosts, a transition whose body does not adopt every changed member of the tuple is either refused with words naming the member it must adopt and how, or, where the specifier rules the transition may proceed, the answer and the lift reads carry a warning that the slot counts no exposure until the named member is adopted; a transition that adopts every changed member behaves byte for byte as today; P49's and P42's units unchanged; kit 02 and 03 state it.

tickets.outcome: An operator who moves a slot's generation after a learn republish is told, on the transition's answer, that the slot will count nothing until the changed member is adopted, or is refused with the member named, instead of a silent 200 and a slot that stops learning.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, after a learn republish that changed a slot's tuple, a transition whose body does not adopt every changed member is refused with words naming the member and how to adopt it, or answers with a warning member stating that the slot counts no exposure until the named member is adopted and the lift reads carry the same warning until it is.
criteria.proof: The P50 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P50.GT1 in src/units/P50 and they pass.

criteria.observable: A transition that adopts every changed member, and a transition on a slot whose tuple did not change, behave byte for byte as today on both hosts; a slot's exposures are counted after it; every P49 and P42 unit is unchanged.
criteria.proof: The P50 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P50.GT2 in src/units/P50 and they pass.

criteria.observable: docs/kit/02-api-reference.md and docs/kit/03-payload-schemas.md state the refusal or the warning and what adopts the member.
criteria.proof: The P50 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P50.GT3 in src/units/P50 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The transition tells the operator what it does not adopt (the owner's rule, R-P78); fail-closed stays.
criteria.proof: Decision D1.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.
criteria.proof: The LIVE1 walkthrough record.

existingEvidence.description: A transition keeps the slot's measurement basis and takes the reward only from its body.
Measured at head and base: a non-adopting transition ends the refusal and the slot's events stay at 0 after a visit; an adopting one counts 3.

remainingWork: Telling: the transition's answer and the lift reads name the member not adopted, or the transition is refused naming it.
Continuity: adopting transitions and unchanged slots byte for byte; P49 and P42 units as locks.
Kit: state it in kit 02 and 03.

decisions.authorityRef: The owner's standing rule of 2026-10-16 (R-P78, _evidence/parity-step3/AMENDMENTS.md; LANE-LOG.md Authority): when a behaviour would surprise the visitor or the operator, the product tells them
decisions.effect: Refusing versus warning is the specifier's choice inside fail-closed; the words and members in the existing shapes.

tickets.title: After a transition whose own publication failed, the reads tell the truth (**amendment 4, 2026-10-17**)

authority.locator: P55 · section 2 of amendment 4; the P49 delivery review section 10 (7.2)
authority.requirement: on both hosts, once a transition for the slot is on record, the lift reads no longer say the transition is what ends the refusal: the specifier rules whether the transition supersedes P49's record with one put after its transaction, or whether the member's endedBy and words change to name what now ends it; every other P49 and P42 behaviour unchanged; kit 02 and 03 state it.

tickets.outcome: An operator who has started the new generation is not told to start it again; the reads name what now holds the slot.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, after a transition whose own publication failed on the pooled cause, the lift reads no longer carry `republished` with `endedBy: 'generation_transition'`: either the member is gone (the transition superseded the record) or it names what now ends it, and the publish answer and the reads agree.
criteria.proof: The P55 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P55.TT1 in src/units/P55 and they pass.

criteria.observable: A transition whose publication succeeds, a refused publication before any transition, and every P42 behaviour are byte for byte as today; every P49 and P42 unit is unchanged.
criteria.proof: The P55 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P55.TT2 in src/units/P55 and they pass.

criteria.observable: docs/kit/02-api-reference.md and docs/kit/03-payload-schemas.md state what the reads say after a transition.
criteria.proof: The P55 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P55.TT3 in src/units/P55 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The reads tell the truth after the operator acts (the owner's rule, R-P78); fail-closed stays.
criteria.proof: Decision D1.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.
criteria.proof: The LIVE1 walkthrough record.

existingEvidence.description: Measured: after a failed transition publication the reads keep stale then republished while the publish answer names the pooled cause.

remainingWork: Lifetime: the transition supersedes or renames the record.
Continuity: everything else byte for byte; P49 and P42 units as locks.
Kit: state it in kit 02 and 03.

decisions.authorityRef: The owner's standing rule of 2026-10-16 (R-P78, _evidence/parity-step3/AMENDMENTS.md; LANE-LOG.md Authority): when a behaviour would surprise the visitor or the operator, the product tells them
decisions.effect: Superseding versus renaming is the specifier's choice inside fail-closed.
